intended_object: A local integral curve around t₀ of a time-dependent vector field v : ℝ × E → E on a real normed space E: a curve γ : ℝ → E with γ'(t) = v(t, γ(t)) for all t in a neighbourhood of t₀. This reading comes from the docstring, the module documentation and the name.
explanation: The body `∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 t₀, HasDerivAt γ (v t (γ t)) t` says that γ has derivative v(t, γ(t)) at every point of some neighbourhood of t₀. That is exactly the standard notion of a local integral curve or local solution of the ODE γ' = v(t, γ). The lemma `isIntegralCurveAt_iff_exists_mem_nhds`, in the same file, shows it is equivalent to being an integral curve on some neighbourhood of t₀. The time variable must be real, and a real normed space is the standard setting for ODEs on vector spaces. The manifold analogue `IsMIntegralCurveAt` only handles autonomous vector fields, so it does not generalise this time-dependent definition. Nothing is missing, extra or too narrow.
